notes.title: Miracle Heroes: Official Open-Source Release!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

After a year of meticulous development, we are excited to announce that Miracle Heroes: Time Treasure Hunter is officially live! This distinctive multiplayer light rogue-like adventure game will take you on a thrilling journey through time and space, filled with unknown challenges and endless possibilities.

Open Source Project Now Available on FAB Marketplace
Alongside the game's release, our open-source project is now available on the FAB Marketplace. As a mature commercial project framework, this type of offering is quite rare on FAB. We warmly encourage Unreal Engine developers to explore our project—it’s completely free. For commercial use, you can purchase the professional-grade assets to support us. Thank you for your continued support!

This project is well-suited for both beginners and advanced developers looking to elevate their skills. We hope it will be a valuable resource for you.

Project Highlights
Controller Support: Fully compatible with gamepad controls.
Local Split-Screen and Online Co-Op: Up to three players can team up.
Mod Support via GameFeatures: Flexible and robust mod integration.
Expandable Game Framework: Designed for ease of development and scalability.
Please note that while our project does not include C++ source code for certain plugins, these plugins are optional and will not affect the core framework's functionality. They mainly provide utility functions such as saving systems and object pooling (as also utilized in our No One Survives project).

Open Source Project vs. Mod Development
Our open-source project differs slightly from the Steam ModKit tools due to adjustments made to comply with FAB Marketplace requirements. We hope these differences won’t impact your mod development experience and invite you to explore the possibilities!

Useful Links
 [Steam] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095600/_/

· [EPIC] https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/miracle-heroes-07c9fb

· [Mod] https://github.com/lvhuming/Miracle-Heroes-Mods-Wiki/wiki

· [FAB] https://www.fab.com/zh-cn/listings/718c064e-2a1e-4434-9f2b-18c37c17ee54


Join Us in Advancing the Miracle Heroes Project!
We sincerely look forward to your participation in shaping the future of Miracle Heroes. Thank you for your incredible support!

Warm regards,
Cat Play Games Studio

notes.title: Miracle Heroes Demo is Officially Live!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Miracle Heroes Demo is Officially Live![/b][/h1]

[b]Dear Adventurers,[/b]

We are thrilled to announce that the demo for Miracle Heroes: Time Treasure Hunter is now officially available! In this unique multiplayer light rogue-like adventure, you will step into the maze of time for the first time, experiencing endless possibilities and challenges.

In the demo, you can experience:

A diverse combination of weapons and items: From ancient relics to future technology, choose the equipment that best suits your style and create your own perfect battle strategy.
Ever-changing levels: Every adventure will be unique. Maps, enemies, and treasures are procedurally generated for each level, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience every time you play.
Co-op and competitive fun: Team up with friends to face powerful enemies together or test your skills against each other in the arena to see who comes out on top.

We are eager to see how you perform in this fantastic world and sincerely welcome your valuable feedback. Your input will help us refine the game and lay a solid foundation for the official release.

[b]The demo is available for a limited time, so download now and be the first to experience it![/b]

Thank you for your support and anticipation, and we look forward to seeing you soon!

notes.title: Regarding Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes: The game is fully compatible with Steam Deck; we're just awaiting evaluation and testing by Valve.
